name: startup-india-goat
description: Research Indian startups and startup groups from cited public and explicitly authorized sources.

settings.name: Extension Directory
settings.description: Extension installation directory (auto-set by Gemini CLI)

settings.name: ScrapeCreators API Key
settings.description: Optional provider key for configured social-source enrichment (never required for public-only research).

settings.name: OpenAI API Key
settings.description: OpenAI API Key - optional fallback for Reddit discovery

settings.name: xAI API Key
settings.description: xAI API Key for X/Twitter search (optional)

settings.name: Twitter AUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: Optional X browser AUTH_TOKEN cookie (use only with CT0 and explicit consent).

settings.name: Twitter CT0
settings.description: Optional X browser CT0 cookie (pair with AUTH_TOKEN).

settings.name: Startup GOAT memory directory
settings.description: Directory for Markdown, HTML, JSON, evidence, and manifest artifacts.

settings.name: LinkedIn access token
settings.description: Explicitly supplied LinkedIn token for permitted company research (optional).

settings.name: LinkedIn session cookies
settings.description: User-supplied LinkedIn session cookies for the cookie-session adapter (optional; LINKEDIN_LI_AT plus LINKEDIN_JSESSIONID and LINKEDIN_BCOOKIE). Held in memory only.

settings.name: Tracxn access token
settings.description: Explicitly supplied Tracxn token for permitted research (optional).
